clusters.name: Walter's move across the country, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move of the family from Millbrook to Sorrel Valley in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, her distance from Walter as he worked the orchard, Glen's fights at his new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, and Walter and June's rows over money for new trees. June's anxiety eased and her functioning rose by September when she joined the church choir, and the period settles there.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when the late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter's heavy drinking, his conflict with Glen over the loan, Glen and Marian's overfunctioning to manage the family's money and talks with the bank, Glen's son Carl's worsening asthma, and Nora's bed-wetting at age eight. Walter stopped drinking and took pruning work by October 1969, and Carl's asthma eased with the spring, where the period settles.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen's months out of work sitting in the truck in the yard, loud fights between Glen and Marian over money at night, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices, Nora's weight loss and stopped eating through the summer, her distance from Marian, and Walter's return to drinking after six years off it. Nora's functioning rose and she was eating again by June 1976 when she made the track team, settling the period.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma's move into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, when Hollis's father had died nineteen years before: Nora's clashes with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, Nora's distance from Hollis as he stayed out of the kitchen rows, Hollis's alignment with his mother, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma's overfunctioning in taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, and rows between Nora and Hollis most nights. Wilma took a flat in town in June 1991, and Nora's eczema cleared over the summer, settling the period.

periods.name: the year Dad lost his job
periods.words: The one that stands out is the year Dad lost his job, when I was 14.

declined.reason: August 1994: four days around the wildfire evacuation, from the order to evacuate to the family allowed home and calm again within the week. All shifts fall within those same few days around a real threat and a family occasion, so this is an acute episode, not a period.

1996–1997: Tess's drinking and conflict with Rick, and Nora's worry and overfunctioning, but the only change in the family on a known date is Tess's own shift, marked neverOpens, so there is not enough in the diagram to choose a reading.
